name: microsoft-teams
title: Microsoft Teams
description: Easily manage your Microsoft Teams presence and status message with this Raycast extension. Search chats and open them in with a keystroke in the Teams app.
author: sven

commands.name: findUser
commands.title: Find User
commands.subtitle: Microsoft Teams
commands.description: Find a user and open a chat.

commands.name: setStatus
commands.title: Set Status
commands.subtitle: Microsoft Teams
commands.description: Set your Microsoft Teams status message (and optionally your presence).

tools.name: get-presence
tools.title: Get Presence
tools.description: Get your current Microsoft Teams presence (availability).

tools.name: clear-presence
tools.title: Clear Presence
tools.description: Clear your manually set Microsoft Teams presence, returning to the automatically calculated presence.

tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Status
tools.description: Get your current Microsoft Teams status message, including its expiry.

tools.name: set-status
tools.title: Set Status
tools.description: Set your Microsoft Teams status message with an optional expiry. Shown above the compose box when people message you by default (pinned).

tools.name: clear-status
tools.title: Clear Status
tools.description: Clear your Microsoft Teams status message.

preferences.name: urlTarget
preferences.title: Open in
preferences.description: Where to open objects: In the Teams web app or the desktop app?
